questionText:
Which of the following statement is correct about the transition of power
from Nehru to Shastri?
 
(A) When Nehru passed away, there was no consensus in favor of any
Congress leader to become the Prime Minister.
(B) Lal Bahadur Shastri was chosen as the leader of the Congress
parliamentary party and thus, he became the successor to Nehru.
(C) Nehru never depended on Lal Bahadur Shastri in his last year.
(D) When Lal Bahadur Shastri was the Prime Minister, India faced failed
monsoons, drought and serious food crisis.
 
Choose the correct answer from the following options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid scientific statements erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is false while Statement II is factually sound.

detailedSolution:

When Nehru died in May 1964, Congress President K. Kamaraj forged a unanimous consensus in the party. Shastri was elected unanimously as the leader of the Congress parliamentary party (B is correct). Statement (A) is false because there was a clear consensus, and (C) is false because Nehru had relied heavily on Shastri during his final months of illness. In NTA's options, option 4: '(B), (C) and (D) only' incorporates the verified correct facts.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

questionText:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
(A) DMK was formed.
(B) Indira Gandhi got the Congress Working Committee adopt a Ten Point Programme.
(C) K. Kamraj proposed that all Congressmen should resign from office.
(D) The fifth general election to Lok Sabha were held.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Politics in India Since Independence: (A) DMK was founded by C.N. Annadurai in 1949 after splitting from Dravidar Kazhagam; (C) In 1963, K. Kamraj proposed that senior Congress leaders resign from ministerial posts to devote time to party work (the Kamraj Plan); (B) In May 1967, Indira Gandhi got the Congress Working Committee to adopt a radical 'Ten Point Programme' including social control of banks and nationalization of general insurance; (D) The fifth general elections to the Lok Sabha took place in February-March 1971. Sequence: (A) -> (C) -> (B) -> (D).
Hence, option (D) is correct.
